personalInfo.name: Yash Dedhia
personalInfo.title: Founding AI Engineer
personalInfo.statement: I build agentic AI systems that hold up in production.
personalInfo.intro: Forward-deployed AI engineer — I sit with stakeholders to scope the problem, then design, ship, and operate the system end to end. Most recently Founding AI Engineer at AI Squared. Founder of ShareMyVault and AgentLens.

experience.summary: Forward Deployed Engineer, partnering with stakeholders to scope requirements, design AI solutions, and deliver production-ready implementations.
bullets: Architected end-to-end agentic workflows with LangGraph — multi-step reasoning, planning, and task execution across multiple cooperating agents.
Designed RAG pipelines combining semantic search with contextual retrieval to improve response accuracy and reduce hallucinations.
Built asynchronous workflow execution with state management and memory persistence for long-running agents.
Cut redundant database queries by 70% with a high-performance caching architecture on Supabase and PostgreSQL.

experience.summary: Work Integrated Learning placement through the RMIT Master of Information Technology.
bullets: Developed a serverless GenAI web application deployed across AWS and Azure.
Implemented RAG pipelines on vector databases to retrieve and contextualise data from multiple file types.
Integrated the RAG pipeline with an internal chatbot for knowledge-based query handling.
Ensured secure data processing, low-latency responses, and production-grade availability.

experience.summary: Backend engineering on enterprise security-analytics products.
bullets: Developed and maintained enterprise-grade backend APIs with .NET Core and MySQL.
Architected and optimised RESTful microservices for security-analytics products.
Improved API performance by 30% and shipped role-based authentication modules.
Worked with QA and DevOps on CI/CD integration and deployment.

products.name: ShareMyVault
products.tagline: Estate planning people can actually finish.
products.description: AI-powered digital estate planning that walks seniors and non-technical users through wills and legacy planning in plain conversation.
bullets: Cross-platform Flutter app with on-device AI inference — private, low-latency, and working without a connection.
Conversations become professionally formatted, legally structured wills and estate documents.
Zero-knowledge, privacy-first backend on Supabase and PostgreSQL with encrypted document storage.

products.name: AgentLens
products.tagline: See your website the way AI does.
products.description: A GenAI platform that evaluates websites for AI-search readiness — accessibility, structured data, crawlability, and LLM interpretability.
bullets: Autonomous crawling pipelines: robots.txt parsing, multi-page exploration, metadata extraction, WCAG audits.
RAG over real-time web data with OpenAI LLMs for context-aware site assessments.
Simulation agents that emulate how ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity read and retrieve a site.
